title: AND-Controlled Relay Snubber Interface
description: MOSFET is not generated; AND output exposes gate-control net GT and the relay/snubber passives are shown as accepted R/L/C records. Requested 100mH/100n are normalized to donor-safe 5mH/1uF visible text.

normalizations.hidden_supply: Ignore user pin 14/VCC/+5V and pin 7/GND/0V for every 74HCxx package.
normalizations.terminal_policy: IC signal pins use $TERINPUT/$TEROUTPUT. R/C/L endpoints use $TERBIDIR. Power/ground terminals only appear when passive branches need V0/G0.

warning: MOSFET donor is not yet accepted; this case exposes GT/DR/SN interface nodes instead of emitting an N-channel MOSFET component.
